title: An open neighbourhood inside a fibre connected component
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $x\in X$. Write $C_x$ for the connected component of $x$ in the subspace $f^{-1}(f(x))$, that is, the maximal connected subset containing $x$ (connectedness [def-weil-connected-scheme]; this subspace is the underlying space of the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]). There exists an open subset $W\subseteq X$ with $x\in W$ and $W\cap f^{-1}(f(x))\subseteq C_x$.

theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_opens_inter_preimage_subset_connectedComponentIn {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      (U : Set X) ∩ f ⁻¹' {f x} ⊆ connectedComponentIn (f ⁻¹' {f x}) x
